entries.title: Your Google sign-in is kept in Secrets
entries.body: Infinitary now keeps the key that renews your Gmail and Calendar sign-in in Secrets, sealed with your system's secret store, instead of in a file. The first time it renews the sign-in, Secrets asks you once; Always allow covers every later renewal. A sign-in you already have moves into Secrets on its own. If you choose Don't allow, Gmail and Calendar wait until you press Check on the Google row.
entries.noPicture: The change is where a key is kept and one Secrets approval card that already exists; no view changes.
